page_title: MAR 1-0 PSG | Marseille v PSG 22/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' It's like he was asking for a caution. Michael Murillo (Marseille) receives a yellow card.
90+4' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
90+3' The ball goes out for a corner. Marseille can continue in their attacking effort.
90+1' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Roberto De Zerbi, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90+1' Roberto De Zerbi appears to have said too much and referee Jerome Brisard comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
89' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Robinio Vaz (Marseille) replaces Mason Greenwood.
89' Substitution. Goncalo Ramos did his best and is replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG).
89' Senny Mayulu (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. PSG force their opponents to concede a corner.

87' Geronimo Rulli makes a brilliant save! Vitinha (PSG) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes straight under the crossbar but is saved by the keeper!

85' PENALTY APPEAL after Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
84' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is able to continue to play.
83' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
79' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bilal Nadir (Marseille) replacing Amine Gouiri.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Michael Murillo (Marseille) comes onto the pitch so that Timothy Weah can be given a rest.
77' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
73' Substitution. Warren Zaire-Emery is replaced by Senny Mayulu (PSG).
73' Kang-In Lee (PSG) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
72' Vitinha (PSG) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Geronimo Rulli.
70' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement.
66' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Goncalo Ramos (PSG), whose header goes wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
64' Substitution. Kang-In Lee (PSG) replaces Willian Pacho.
64' PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
63' Nuno Mendes (PSG) crosses the ball into the box from a free kick, but Geronimo Rulli reads it well and gathers the ball.
61' Substitution. Igor Paixao walks off the pitch and Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
60' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

59' Vitinha (PSG) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
58' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
50' Timothy Weah (Marseille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jerome Brisard ignores the protests.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Unlucky! A rebound falls at the feet of Igor Paixao (Marseille), and he hits a first-time exocet from long range that flies a whisker past the left post.
45+1' Vitinha (PSG) crosses the ball in from a free kick, but Geronimo Rulli reads it well and gathers the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
43' Timothy Weah (Marseille) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Now Marseille have a corner.
36' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle after Timothy Weah (Marseille) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
31' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
28' Marseille have a goal ruled out for offside!
26' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
18' Today's referee Jerome Brisard rightly decides to book Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) for his harsh tackle.
17' That didn't go as planned! Vitinha (PSG) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Geronimo Rulli, who easily kept it out.

13' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
11' PSG are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
5' 1 - 0 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Marquinhos (PSG), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but heads the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:0.
4' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Lucas Chevalier has no trouble gathering it.

4' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jerome Brisard.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
